headline: Govt employees to get 5-day Durga Puja holiday
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has declared an additional holiday on October 22, extending the break to five consecutive days.
details: Government employees will enjoy a five-day consecutive holiday from October 20 to 24 for Durga Puja. The Prime Minister declared an additional holiday on October 22, which was previously a working day.
The holiday break includes October 20 (Navami), October 21 (Bijoya Dashami), the newly added October 22, and the weekly holidays on October 23 and 24.
Alongside the holiday, the government has increased grants for religious festivals. The Hindu Religious Welfare Trust received 5 crore BDT, exceeding their request of 4 crore BDT.
Similarly, the Buddhist Religious Welfare Trust was allocated 3 crore BDT for the 'Kothin Chibar Dan' ceremony, surpassing their request of 2 crore BDT.
Essential services including hospitals, police, fire service, and utility providers will continue to operate during the holidays.
Banks and financial institutions will generally remain closed, though digital services like ATMs and online banking will remain operational as per Bangladesh Bank guidelines.
caption:
A 5-day break is coming! Government employees will get a consecutive holiday for Durga Puja.

Government employees will enjoy a five-day consecutive holiday from October 20 to 24 for Durga Puja. The Prime Minister declared an additional holiday on October 22, which was previously a working day.

The holiday break includes October 20 (Navami), October 21 (Bijoya Dashami), the newly added October 22, and the weekly holidays on October 23 and 24.

Alongside the holiday, the government has increased grants for religious festivals. The Hindu Religious Welfare Trust received 5 crore BDT, exceeding their request of 4 crore BDT.

Similarly, the Buddhist Religious Welfare Trust was allocated 3 crore BDT for the 'Kothin Chibar Dan' ceremony, surpassing their request of 2 crore BDT.

Essential services including hospitals, police, fire service, and utility providers will continue to operate during the holidays.

Banks and financial institutions will generally remain closed, though digital services like ATMs and online banking will remain operational as per Bangladesh Bank guidelines.

headline: 1,104 dead as measles outbreak death toll rises
summary: Five people died in the last 24 hours as the measles crisis continues to escalate.
details: A measles outbreak has resulted in 1,104 deaths, with five people dying in the last 24 hours.
The rising death toll highlights the severity of the current health crisis.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation as the outbreak continues to spread.
